{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Intensity Momentum", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year change in R&D expenses scaled by average total assets over the same period", "rationale": "Firms with increasing R&D investment are more likely to experience future growth and innovation, leading to higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Taxes Paid Ratio", "construction": "Compute the ratio of income taxes paid to pretax income over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with lower taxes paid may be taking excessive risks or engaging in tax avoidance schemes, while firms with higher taxes paid may be more profitable and stable", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Calculate the 2-year growth rate of total employees", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing workforces may be experiencing rapid expansion and increasing demand for their products or services", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Efficiency", "construction": "Compute the ratio of advertising expenses to sales over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with lower advertising expenses relative to sales may be more efficient in their marketing efforts and have stronger brand recognition", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Funding Status", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of pension assets to pension liabilities as reported in the footnotes", "rationale": "Firms with better-funded pension plans may have lower future liabilities and higher financial flexibility", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "Estimate the ratio of environmental liabilities to total assets using data from the footnotes and industry reports", "rationale": "Firms with lower environmental liabilities may have lower future costs and reputational risks associated with environmental degradation", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Patent Citation Count", "construction": "Count the number of patent citations received by a firm's patents over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with more highly-cited patents may have more innovative and valuable intellectual property", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Labor Union Coverage", "construction": "Estimate the percentage of employees covered by labor unions using data from industry reports and company filings", "rationale": "Firms with lower labor union coverage may have more flexible labor costs and lower risk of labor disputes", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Giving Ratio", "construction": "Compute the ratio of charitable donations to net income over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with higher corporate giving may have stronger community relationships and reputations, while firms with lower giving may be more focused on shareholder value", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "North American Revenue Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the percentage of total revenue earned in North America over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with higher revenue concentration in North America may be more exposed to regional economic trends and have lower diversification benefits", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
